application-id.description: Reported application/package/bundle identifier; distinct from a display name.

artifact-id.description: Producer artifact identifier, scoped to its case and data source; not a globally unique identity.

artifact-type.description: Explicit TSK artifact type or unsupported producer artifact type; never inferred from a URL or filename.

case-id.description: Explicit case identifier supplied by the export or analyst.

data-source.description: Reported data source label/name, kept distinct from a database identifier.

data-source-id.description: Explicit evidence data source identifier within the case.

device-id.description: Explicit device identifier; not inferred from a participant address or application.

event-time.description: Normalized artifact time only when its units and timezone are explicit; meaning depends on artifact type.

evidence-id.description: Explicit evidence or extraction identifier supplied by the export or analyst.

producer.description: Source tool/parser name. For normalized interchange, this is caller-provided attribution, not authenticated native format detection.

producer-version.description: Explicit source tool/parser version, if provided.

raw-record.description: Exact selected JSON row text, or normalized JSON of all original CSV cell strings, including unmapped fields. Source-format identifies the representation; the report is authoritative for full-export bytes.

record-number.description: One-based original data-row ordinal; CSV header is excluded, and selection never renumbers retained rows.

review-status.description: Unreviewed forensic observation; importing a result does not establish malicious activity.

source-context.description: Effective producer/case/selection context applied to this row, kept separately from the raw row.

source-file.description: Reported source path or forensic container member; never opened on the importer host.

source-format.description: Parsed input contract: autopsy-csv or selected-json.

source-object-id.description: Explicit source content/object identifier in the forensic case.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of exact input report bytes, including rows excluded by explicit selection; not a hash of the underlying device/image.

description: A selected Autopsy or normalized mobile-forensic artifact with producer, case/device, source-record and evidence provenance. Link to its report and derived tsk-* or software objects; source paths are references, not files to fetch.
name: forensic-artifact
